name: Talmarr
role: Paladin, Shield of Emberheart, Wife of Kaelrath
title: Kaelrath's Bonded Shield
bio: Elven paladin and Kaelrath's first bonded companion. She is his shield in all things — diplomatic, martial, and spiritual. Her divine oath binds her to the flame.
motivation: Protect Kaelrath and their family while maintaining the divine balance of the kingdom.
